SQL independently requires passed pin equals installed compiled checksum through caller_ready(public-api,pin). No unbound installed-checksum-only selection.

public_scalar_rules: Canonical full product IDs; generation/version positive1..MaxInt64; replay_floor0..MaxInt64. Device name1..128UTF8bytes trimmed/no control. All server metadata timestamps canonicalUTC RFC3339Nano <=6fraction digits without trailingzeros; retain original native instants. Tokenbundle expiry canonical wholeUTC seconds. Unknown/duplicate/null/casealias/trailing reject except explicitly nullable metadata below.

device_dto.source: Exact original native device metadata; current version/state on GET. Do not turn pending/active into health/coverage claim.

enrollment_dto.source: Native15 format1 row in exact scope/device. device_version means original device_version_at_issue, not current device version. Original issued_at/expires_at stable; consumed/revoked are current row facts on GET, original own receipt snapshot on mutation replay.

get_response.latest_enrollment: EnrollmentDTO or explicit null; exact scope/device FORMAT1 only, greatest token_generation LIMIT1, no legacy-token false claim. No unbounded history.
get_response.next_credential_generation: Authoritative COALESCE(max(format1 credential_generation),0)+1 under current org/device serialization; fail on MaxInt64 overflow. A metadata hint, not a guarantee or privilege; issue rederives and binds authoritative value.
get_response.issuance_state_order: device_unavailable when state not pending/active; else existing_credential when ANY original unrevoked format1 credential (including expired) because native enroll refuses those; else existing_enrollment when ANY original format1 token unconsumed+unrevoked (including expired); else available. Does not imply a revoked token revokes a credential.

create_response.replayed: false fresh original own mutation; true exact prior metadata receipt. No secret.

issue_response.token_bundle: Present ONLY fresh exact sameTX native token insertion AND confirmed COMMIT; never null, absent on metadata replay. Replay response includes original device/enrollment receipt snapshots, not fresh generated candidates; client refetch GET for current status.

revoke_response.replayed: Original metadata snapshot exact prior receipt if true; false freshly recorded native revoke. Original token id/device match; no credential revocation claim.

bundle_dto.enrollment_expires_at: Whole-second UTC exact native token expiry. Must remain future at final DBclock check before COMMIT.
bundle_dto.credential_generation: Current authoritative next original native credential_generation returned/bound by own SQL receipt, never client-supplied. Recheck original no-unrevoked-credential condition at issue and final confirm.

internal_sql_receipt.operation: Exact createGatewayDevice|issueGatewayEnrollment|revokeGatewayEnrollment. create has enrollment=null,credential_generation=null; revoke has enrollment DTO,credential_generation=null; issue has DTO and positive authoritative next credential generation.
internal_sql_receipt.new_mutation: TRUE only this operation newly performed original native effect AND inserted own receipt in current pg_current_xact_id. Own receipt row has immutable created_tx xid8 DEFAULT pg_current_xact_id(). Existing receipt replay returns FALSE regardless native metadata equality; never trust caller/GUC/HTTP boolean. Native issue result replayed:true with absent own receipt MUST NOT become new_mutation:true.
internal_sql_receipt.own_storage: Persist stable result without new_mutation/replayed presentation markers, exact canonical intent digest, actual generated native material binding, original recorded_at, created_tx. Native material binding covers exact device/tokenID, token generation/deviceVersion, locator_digest32,salt32,token_hash32,expiry and authoritative next credentialgen. Hash/private fields never public DTO/audit; plaintext secret/locator never stored.
internal_sql_receipt.confirmation: Same actual authorization-context READ COMMITTED transaction: fixed mutation -> strictinternalreceipt decode -> exact confirm_public(expected_receipt,pin) -> COMMIT. Confirm rechecks own exact scope/actor/operation/key/digest, stable receipt and current created_tx marker; compares every returned field; uses current proof+identity/revision/profile/pin/native state+postwait expiry. Publicsecretrelease requires new_mutation=true AND replayed=false AND original exact input IDs/hash generation/expiry binding; COMMIT success. Unknown commit never secretrelease.
internal_sql_receipt.replay_discipline: Exact historical mutation receipt replay always new_mutation=false/replayed=true; no new audit, no native effect, no token material redisclosure. Canonical intent excludes all generated randomness and includes normalized operation/scope/actor/idempotency/body/path device/enrollment/expectedversion/TTL; changed intent conflicts. Current full permission/fresh policy still required for replay.

headers_and_inputs.all: Production HTTPS, noquery, strict JSON exactbody and existing scope headers. Cache-Control:no-store and Pragma:no-cache on success/error containing flow state. No token URLs/logs/storage.
headers_and_inputs.mutations: Exactly one Idempotency-Key using existing canonical16..128 ASCII public idempotency rule. Required JSON media. Reject If-Match because expected_version is explicit body field (avoid conflicting version sources). create body{name}; issue body{expected_version,ttl_seconds60..86400}; revoke body{expected_version}. No generated IDs/gens/hashes/secret in user body.
headers_and_inputs.GET: No body, no mutation idempotency/version/fresh headers; normal current view authorization. Exact metadata refetch after create/issue/revoke and scope/identity change.
headers_and_inputs.authority: Browser mutation current CSRF/origin/scope plus real fresh auth and X-Zasp-Fresh-Auth:confirmed. PAT requires manage_identity ceiling/current grant, rejects browser fresh-auth header. Read current view; all environment allowed target(e), noncollection. No organization identity.manage shortcut.

unknown_response_recovery: A lost/unknown issue may have committed: replay gives metadata without secret; GET shows actuallatest token; deliberate exact revoke using new idempotency then issue with NEW idempotency creates fresh token. Never automatic retry/mint or claim old request never committed. Existing credential blockage is reported explicitly and is outside enrollment-token revocation.
limits: Source proposal only. No product change, SQL/native execution or tests. Root merge must update prior arities and every acceptance classifier/CLI/SDK contract together.
